cue: A nearest-neighbor Potts proof transfers a mean-field jump to q=3,d=3 using an approximate-minimizer allowance.
fire_when: A proposed q=3 lattice jump uses the Biskup-Chayes error bound without comparing it with a separating barrier in the same spin normalization.
silent_when: The text reports only a mean-field special case, or explicitly verifies a smaller allowance and supplies the critical-point identification.
text: Mean-field jump transfer needs an error smaller than its separating barrier, in the same normalization. For q=3, Delta=log(3)-19log(2)/12 is tiny; the coarse d=3 allowance is >272.8 Delta. A jump at Jt also needs Jt=Jc for C0048.
